newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Rouble o/n credits eased on c.bank, client selling.
newsitem.headline: Rouble o/n credits eased on c.bank, client selling.

text.p: Rouble overnight credit rates eased on Tuesday after the central bank saturated the market on Monday, selling roubles to commercial banks, and dealers said funds were also coming from client dollar buying.
roubles/dollar Apr 22 midday Apr 22 early Apr 21 close
"It looks like the central bank injected many roubles through the rouble/dollar market yesterday. Credit rates have eased, it is not a typical Tuesday," ABN-Amro Bank dealer Artur Lotov said.
The rouble usually firms ahead of Wednesday's sales of government securities.

On April 23, the finance ministry will auction 7.50 trillion roubles of 364-day GKO discount Treasury bills (series 23005) and 4.00 trillion roubles in an additional 707-day tranche of the two-year bonds maturing March 1999 (series 24011).
